articles.title: Ethereum whale who shorted October 2025 crash opens $19.7M ETH short position
articles.snippet: Ether’s technical setup points to a potential drop to $1,375, a move that could lift one whale’s unrealized profit to $2.39 million.

articles.title: The Future Cyberpunk Imagined Is Here: How Much Did It Get Right?
articles.snippet: From AI to brain implants, cyberpunk got more right than many people realize. Its biggest prediction, however, wasn't the technology.

articles.title: The Stablecoin Founder Map Doesn't Match the Stablecoin Volume Map
articles.snippet: Emerging markets drive most real-world stablecoin usage, yet founder concentration and venture funding remain U.S.- and Europe-centric.

articles.title: AI Took Your Job? California Wants to Know
articles.snippet: California launched the nation's first AI unemployment tracker as policymakers race to determine whether warnings of an AI-driven jobs shakeup are becoming a reality.
